newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market quiet on European competition.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market quiet on European competition.

text.p: Values for woollen tops prices saw little change as competitive pricing by European producers and new currency factors kept buyers in their starting-blocks, Bradford wool market sources said on Monday.
"Heavy low-priced sales from two of the main Continental sources (of supply) have helped to prevent buying in the UK," one broker said.
The recent strength of sterling has removed the opportunity to increase quotations in line with the cost of imported wool for blending while pushing up the price of UK exports, another added.
The absence of major buyers from the market due to late holidays has also had a dampening effect on demand, brokers said.
